title: Q-GROW-front-door-example-systems: Three concrete running systems on the front door raise taps into the interview.
body:

**Done check:** grep:doctrine/growth.json::"id": "front-door-example-systems"
**Prediction:** pilot_applications_7d >= 5 within 168 h
**Status:** open
